title: Beard Styles for Men: AI Face Shape Detector & Custom Beard Design
excerpt: AI detects your face shape locally, recommends the best beard style, and creates a photorealistic custom beard design.
content_html:
Get Your Best Beard Design

Upload a photo or take a selfie. We detect your face shape locally, remove any existing facial hair, and generate the strongest beard match for your face. Every generation costs 10 credits.
